t: 维多利亚女王险些逃脱罗德里克·麦克莱恩在温莎的暗杀企图。

dz: 维多利亚女王险些逃脱罗德里克·麦克莱恩在温莎的暗杀企图。

te: Britain's first electric trams run in east London.
dz: 英国首台电动有轨电车在伦敦东部开行.

dz: 罗伯特·克赫宣布发现了由细菌负责结核病的Mycobacterium结核病.

dz: 哥伦布骑士团成立.

dz: 美国"老西部":罗伯特·福特杀死了杰西·詹姆斯.
de: American Old West: Robert Ford kills Jesse James.

de: French and Vietnamese troops clash in Tonkin, when Commandant Henri Rivière seizes the citadel of Hanoi with a small force of marine infantry.

te: The United States Congress passes the Chinese Exclusion Act.
dz: 美国国会通过"中国排斥法".
de: The United States Congress passes the Chinese Exclusion Act.

t: 托马斯·亨利·伯克和弗雷德里克·卡文迪什勋爵被都柏林凤凰公园的芬尼亚刺客刺死.

dz: 托马斯·亨利·伯克和弗雷德里克·卡文迪什勋爵被都柏林凤凰公园的芬尼亚刺客刺死.
de: Thomas Henry Burke and Lord Frederick Cavendish are stabbed to death by Fenian assassins in Phoenix Park, Dublin.

t: 德意志帝国,奥地利-匈牙利和意大利王国三国联盟相继成立.
te: The Triple Alliance between the German Empire, Austria-Hungary and the Kingdom of Italy is formed.
dz: 德意志帝国,奥地利-匈牙利和意大利王国三国联盟相继成立.
de: The Triple Alliance between the German Empire, Austria-Hungary and the Kingdom of Italy is formed.

t: 埃塞俄比亚的梅内利克二世的谢万部队在恩巴博战役中击败了戈贾梅军队. 谢万人夺取了戈贾姆的内古斯…
te: The Shewan forces of Menelik II of Ethiopia defeat the Gojjame army in the Battle of Embabo. The Shewans capture Negus …
dz: 埃塞俄比亚的梅内利克二世的谢万部队在恩巴博战役中击败了戈贾梅军队. 谢万人夺取了戈贾姆的内古斯·特克勒·海马诺特(Negus Tekle Haymanot),他们的胜利导致了谢万人对阿拜河以南领地的霸权.
de: The Shewan forces of Menelik II of Ethiopia defeat the Gojjame army in the Battle of Embabo. The Shewans capture Negus Tekle Haymanot of Gojjam, and their victory leads to a Shewan hegemony over the territories south of the Abay River.

t: 在亚历山大爆发了针对外国统治的民族主义暴乱. 50多名欧洲人被杀死,其中包括英国领事.
te: Nationalist riots break out in Alexandria directed against foreign domination. More than 50 Europeans are killed, inclu…
dz: 在亚历山大爆发了针对外国统治的民族主义暴乱. 50多名欧洲人被杀死,其中包括英国领事.
de: Nationalist riots break out in Alexandria directed against foreign domination. More than 50 Europeans are killed, including the British consul.

t: 1882年的英法公约标志着几内亚和塞拉利昂的领土边界.
te: The Anglo-French Convention of 1882 marks the territorial boundaries between Guinea and Sierra Leone.
dz: 1882年的英法公约标志着几内亚和塞拉利昂的领土边界.
de: The Anglo-French Convention of 1882 marks the territorial boundaries between Guinea and Sierra Leone.

t: 查尔斯·J·吉托(Charles J. Guiteau)被绞死在华盛顿特区,罪名是刺杀美国总统…
te: Charles J. Guiteau is hanged in Washington, D.C. for the assassination of U.S. President James Garfield.
dz: 查尔斯·J·吉托(Charles J. Guiteau)被绞死在华盛顿特区,罪名是刺杀美国总统詹姆斯·加菲尔德.
de: Charles J. Guiteau is hanged in Washington, D.C. for the assassination of U.S. President James Garfield.

t: 智利在拉康塞普西翁战役中遭受了最后的军事失败,当时一支由1 300人组成的秘鲁部队消灭了由77…
te: Chile suffers its last military defeat in the Battle of La Concepción when a garrison of 77 men is annihilated by a 1,3…
dz: 太平洋战争:智利在拉康塞普西翁战役中遭受了最后的军事失败,当时一支由1 300人组成的秘鲁部队消灭了由77人组成的驻军,其中许多人配备了长矛.
de: War of the Pacific: Chile suffers its last military defeat in the Battle of La Concepción when a garrison of 77 men is annihilated by a 1,300-strong Peruvian force, many of them armed with spears.

t: 作为盎格鲁-埃及战争的一部分,英国地中海舰队在埃及开始轰炸亚历山大.
te: The British Mediterranean Fleet begins the Bombardment of Alexandria in Egypt as part of the Anglo-Egyptian War.
dz: 作为盎格鲁-埃及战争的一部分,英国地中海舰队在埃及开始轰炸亚历山大.
de: The British Mediterranean Fleet begins the Bombardment of Alexandria in Egypt as part of the Anglo-Egyptian War.

t: 斯特拉兰共和国成立于南部非洲.
te: The Republic of Stellaland is founded in Southern Africa.
dz: 斯特拉兰共和国成立于南部非洲.
de: The Republic of Stellaland is founded in Southern Africa.

t: 理查·瓦格纳在拜罗伊特的歌剧"Persifal"的总理.
te: Premiere of Richard Wagner's opera Parsifal at Bayreuth.
dz: 理查·瓦格纳在拜罗伊特的歌剧"Persifal"的总理.
de: Premiere of Richard Wagner's opera Parsifal at Bayreuth.

t: 新泽西州标准石油公司,今天称为埃克森美孚公司,正式成立. 该公司后来会成长为所有标准石油公司的…
te: Standard Oil Company of New Jersey, today known as ExxonMobil, is established officially. The company would later grow …
dz: 新泽西州标准石油公司,今天称为埃克森美孚公司,正式成立. 该公司后来会成长为所有标准石油公司的持有者,并成为标准石油公司解体的中心实体.
de: Standard Oil Company of New Jersey, today known as ExxonMobil, is established officially. The company would later grow to become the holder of all Standard Oil companies and the entity at the center of the breakup of Standard Oil.

t: 黑色乐队 一群无政府主义者的矿工 开始了Montceau -les.
te: Start of the second part of the Montceau-les-Mines troubles by the Black Band, groups of anarchist miners.
dz: 黑色乐队 一群无政府主义者的矿工 开始了Montceau -les.
de: Start of the second part of the Montceau-les-Mines troubles by the Black Band, groups of anarchist miners.

t: 柴可夫斯基的《1812 年序曲》在俄罗斯莫斯科首演。
te: Tchaikovsky's 1812 Overture debuts in Moscow, Russia.
dz: 柴可夫斯基的《1812 年序曲》在俄罗斯莫斯科首演。
de: Tchaikovsky's 1812 Overture debuts in Moscow, Russia.

t: 纽约市珍珠街站成为第一个向付费客户提供电力的发电厂.
te: The Pearl Street Station in New York City becomes the first power plant to supply electricity to paying customers.
dz: 纽约市珍珠街站成为第一个向付费客户提供电力的发电厂.
de: The Pearl Street Station in New York City becomes the first power plant to supply electricity to paying customers.

dz: 美国第一次劳动节游行在纽约市举行.
de: The first United States Labor Day parade is held in New York City.

te: A British force repels an Egyptian force led by Ahmed Urabi in the battle of Qassasin during the Anglo-Egyptian War.
dz: 一支英国部队击退了一支由艾哈迈德·乌拉比率领的埃及部队,在盎格鲁-埃及战争期间的卡萨辛战役.
de: A British force repels an Egyptian force led by Ahmed Urabi in the battle of Qassasin during the Anglo-Egyptian War.

t: 英军在特尔克比尔战役中击败了埃及军队.
te: English forces defeat the Egyptian army in the battle of Tel el-Kebir.
dz: 盎格鲁-埃及战争:英军在特尔克比尔战役中击败了埃及军队.
de: Anglo-Egyptian War: English forces defeat the Egyptian army in the battle of Tel el-Kebir.

t: 太平洋证券交易所开业.
te: The Pacific Stock Exchange opens.
dz: 太平洋证券交易所开业.
de: The Pacific Stock Exchange opens.

t: 托马斯·爱迪生的第一座商业水力发电厂——火神街发电厂开始运营。
te: Thomas Edison's first commercial hydroelectric power plant, the Vulcan Street Plant, begins operation.
dz: 托马斯·爱迪生的第一座商业水力发电厂——火神街发电厂开始运营。

te: The Nickel Plate Railroad opens for business.
dz: 镍板铁路投入运营。
de: The Nickel Plate Railroad opens for business.

te: Anarchists such as Fanny Madignier commit the first deadly anarchist attack in France.
dz: 阿索穆瓦爆炸案：范妮·马迪尼耶等无政府主义者在法国制造了第一起致命的无政府主义袭击。
de: Assommoir bombing: Anarchists such as Fanny Madignier commit the first deadly anarchist attack in France.

t: 大火摧毁了芬兰奥卢省的一大部分奥卢市中心.
te: The great fire destroys a large part of Oulu's city center in Oulu Province, Finland.
dz: 大火摧毁了芬兰奥卢省的一大部分奥卢市中心.
de: The great fire destroys a large part of Oulu's city center in Oulu Province, Finland.

t: 19世纪后期和后期的金星过境.
te: Transit of Venus, second and last of the 19th century.
dz: 19世纪后期和后期的金星过境.
de: Transit of Venus, second and last of the 19th century.

t: 威尔士和英格兰参加首届"家乡"(现为"六国")橄榄球联盟比赛.
te: Wales and England contest the first Home Nations (now Six Nations) rugby union match.
dz: 威尔士和英格兰参加首届"家乡"(现为"六国")橄榄球联盟比赛.
